lines.speaker: Deacon Mealy
lines.text: Another stray off the boat? The Bethel sees everything.

lines.speaker: Deacon Mealy
lines.text: Package is at the pier. The contact owes the Republic money. How do you want this done?

lines.speaker: Deacon Mealy
lines.text: Quiet money. Heat stays low if you are quick. The pew has a scrimshaw tooth if you need a stake.

lines.speaker: Deacon Mealy
lines.text: Loud is a choice. Take a car. Do not make me read about you. And pocket the tooth in the pew — you'll want the cash.

conversations.speaker: Pier Contact
lines: You Mealy's new errand dog? Figures.
Package is in the trunk. Republic boys already sniffing around.
Do not die on my planks — paperwork is a nightmare.

lines.speaker: Republic Runner
lines.text: Linguica does not deliver itself. Off the Hook still owes us two favors.

lines.speaker: Republic Runner
lines.text: You driving it downtown, or are you just here to drink?

lines.speaker: Republic Runner
lines.text: Smile for the cameras you cannot see.

lines.speaker: Republic Runner
lines.text: One drink. Then the car. The Republic does not do tabs for new faces.
